description: DEBONAIR UltraPlay Mic Full HD Smart Projector The DEBONAIR UltraPlay Mic Full HD Projector brings an immersive, theater-like entertainment experience to your home, office, or classroom, now enhanced with a **powerful 10W built-in speaker and microphone support** for a more engaging multimedia experience. With **native 1920 × 1080 Full HD resolution and 1,100 ANSI lumens of brightness, the UltraPlay Mic delivers sharp, detailed visuals with vibrant colors and excellent clarity across a wide range of viewing environments. It supports a large projection size from **40 to 250 inches**, with a throw distance of approximately **1 to 5 meters**, making it suitable for both compact rooms and larger spaces. The projector features a **fully sealed optical engine** that helps protect the internal optics from dust, ensuring reliable performance and long-term durability. With a lamp lifespan of **over 50,000 hours**, you can enjoy years of entertainment without frequent lamp replacements. For effortless setup, the UltraPlay Mic comes with **automatic keystone correction**, making it easy to achieve a properly aligned image without complicated manual adjustments.
